parts.name: Radiator
parts.description: A heat exchanger of thin tubes and fins. It is drawn here mounted ahead of the engine.
parts.function: Hot coolant from the engine flows through the radiator's tubes, and air passing over the fins carries the heat away before the coolant returns to the engine.
parts.verificationNote: Honda confirms the 2026 engine is liquid-cooled; the RADIATOR diagram is listed in the 2026 catalog index.

parts.name: Radiator Fan
parts.description: An electric cooling fan. Whether the 2026 CMX500A has one, and its part number, are not yet verified.
parts.function: On liquid-cooled motorcycles a fan pulls air through the radiator when the bike is moving slowly or stopped, so there is too little natural airflow.

parts.name: Water Pump
parts.description: An engine-driven impeller pump that circulates coolant.
parts.function: Keeps coolant moving through the engine's water jackets and the radiator whenever the engine is running.

parts.name: Thermostat
parts.description: A temperature-sensitive valve in the coolant circuit.
parts.function: Stays closed while the engine is cold so coolant bypasses the radiator and the engine warms up quickly. It opens at operating temperature to send coolant through the radiator.

parts.name: Coolant Hoses
parts.description: Rubber hoses that carry coolant between the engine and the radiator.
parts.function: Close the coolant loop: hot coolant goes out to the radiator and cooled coolant comes back to the engine. The routing shown here is representative only.
parts.verificationNote: Hose routing and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
